Stare at the pink dot.
Did your clock freeze?
Stare at the pink dot.
Look at the dot.
Now jump your eyes
to the clock.
That first tick seemed
to hang.
The video didn't lag.
While your eyes jump,
your brain switches off
the blurry view.
Then it fills the gap
with the clock,
as if you'd been looking
all along.
That borrowed time lands
on the first tick.
It can feel up to half
a second longer.
And your eyes jump about
three times a second.
